title: Numbers 11–20 and Weather
label: ch:ml-numbers-and-weather
canDo: I can count from eleven to twenty in Malayalam and say what the weather is doing.

payoff.summary: Count 11 and 12 as ten-plus-a-digit and split irupatŭ into "two-tens", then say kālāvastha as 'the state of time', split it into kālam and avastha, and add maḻa peyyunnu for rain.
payoff.note: ML-C20-kalavastha assesses four of the chapter's five atoms: both number atoms (ML-C20-pathinonnu-irupathu, now a prerequisite) and both weather atoms. The letter ദ (ML-S123-letter-da, 501) is taught after the payoff and is not assessed.
